title: Instruction labels for the path-hardness machine
statement: For natural numbers $a$, $b$, and $f$, define the type of instruction labels to consist of the constructors listed below: the unindexed labels, together with labels indexed by a Boolean value, an element of $	ext{Fin }2$, $	ext{Fin }3$, $	ext{Fin }4$, $	ext{Fin }5$, $	ext{Fin }9$, $	ext{Fin }a$, $	ext{Fin }b$, or $	ext{Fin }f$, in exactly the combinations specified by the constructors. Here $	ext{Fin }m$ denotes the set of natural numbers less than $m$.
